name: Rick
description: The hero of Night Wagon, a 1980s TV action series: a grim, intense driver who talks to his station wagon, Buddy.

look.description: a mid-30s man with a big dark mullet, in a black leather jacket over a white tee, driving at night, lit by the glow of the dashboard's rows of red, yellow and green buttons
never: any resemblance to a real actor
a jacket in any other colour or cut

stills.note: at the wheel, lit by the dashboard, the take all his lines in Take 9 come from

voice.notes: Rick's voice is the video model's own, so it varies between takes; Takes 7 and 9 cut all his lines from one continuous take (nw7-rick-lines-t1). A swap voice is not chosen yet.

delivery.register: grim and intense, getting more urgent line by line, always the same energy

levels.source: Rick's lines in the approved Night Wagon Take 9

changelog.changes: First version: look from the Night Wagon storyboards and the approved Take 9; delivery from Rick's lines there. Reference levels measured from 5 approved lines (Rick's lines in the approved Night Wagon Take 9): -26.4 to -18.2 LUFS, 129 to 407 Hz, pitch range up to 21.7 st, 2.00 to 7.50 words/s.
